install_destination_concept: After closeout approval only, copy an immutable reviewed overlay into the resolved DollyArchitect profile directory beneath that profile's HERMES_HOME; do not modify shared skills.
deferred_runtime_wiring_seam: A later reviewed change may teach the profile loader and Kanban dispatcher to consume the installed overlay. This candidate does not register or call that seam.
install_actions: verify a Hermes-created candidate commit and tree after closeout
review the candidate package and scoped verification receipts
have DollyOps install the reviewed files into a profile-local inactive overlay
separately approve and implement runtime wiring only in a later change
rollback_actions: disable any later profile-local loader reference before removal
remove only the installed DollyArchitect candidate overlay
restore the prior profile-local overlay snapshot if one existed
rerun profile load and no-live-mutation checks
live_no_mutation_boundary: a local candidate commit is permitted for provenance and does not install or activate the candidate
no live profile or shared skill changes
no dispatcher, Kanban schema, gateway, notifier, or runtime registration
no credentials, provider, model, auth, service, product-chain, or telemetry mutation
no remote or public push, pull request, release, or deploy
post_closeout_sequence: Hermes creates and records the exact candidate commit and tree
independent review validates the closed candidate
DollyOps performs any approved profile-local install
runtime wiring remains a separate reviewed change
